p/p.synod:5:8: error[bad-receiver]: a receiver has type Node or p.Node, not number
  |
5 | define [n: number] Foo
  |        ^

p/p.synod:8:8: error[bad-receiver]: the receiver of start is [n: Node]
  |
8 | define [n: text] start
  |        ^

   |
11 | define start
   |        ^

p/p.synod:14:6: error[bad-receiver]: the receiver of a when is [n: Node]
   |
14 | when [n: number] (net.Received m from a)
   |      ^

p/p.synod:17:1: error[bad-receiver]: "net.Received" is a node event: write "when [n: Node] (…)"
   |
17 | when (net.Received m from a)
   | ^

p/p.synod:21:6: error[bad-receiver]: "sim.Added" is a trace event: remove the receiver

   |      ^
